headline: Bitcoin sits near $76,000 as the main crypto sentiment gauge slips to Extreme Fear, while MEXC's USDT withdrawals stay disrupted after a US Treasury cut-off order.

market.asOf: Read by the desk from CoinGecko at about 19:52 UTC Sat 7 Nov (02:52 Sun Bangkok). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme Fear: the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 25 (Extreme Fear) when checked at about 19:51 UTC Sat 7 Nov, down from 28 (Fear) the day before.

stories.title: MEXC's USDT withdrawals stay disrupted after the US Treasury orders a cut-off
stories.summary: The US Treasury's financial-crimes unit, FinCEN, issued a final rule barring US banks and payment firms from handling transfers involving crypto exchange MEXC. MEXC says some USDT stablecoin withdrawals are paused for routine network maintenance, and money has been flowing out of the exchange.
points: FinCEN says MEXC has facilitated at least $16 billion in illicit transactions.
The order takes effect 30 days after it is published in the Federal Register.
An independent tracker showed only 6 of 18 USDT withdrawal networks working; Ethereum was up while TRON, Solana, BNB Chain, Arbitrum and Polygon were down, per FinanceFeeds.
MEXC saw about $126M of net outflows over 24 hours, per DefiLlama data cited by cryptonews.net.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $76,000 as sentiment slips to Extreme Fear
stories.summary: Bitcoin has barely moved on Saturday, but the most-watched sentiment gauge has dropped into Extreme Fear and money is still leaving US bitcoin funds. Tuesday's US inflation report is the next big data point.
points: Bitcoin was $76,067.80 on CoinGecko at about 19:52 UTC Saturday, up 0.5% over 24 hours.
The alternative.me Fear & Greed Index read 25, Extreme Fear, down from 28 (Fear) a day earlier.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had $411.9M of net outflows on 6 Nov and about $1.28B over the 2-6 Nov week, per crypto.news.
Friday's low of $74,762 was the lowest since 21 Aug, per Cointelegraph.

stories.title: Binance hack: hackers now hold about 2,300 newly bought bitcoin
stories.summary: The people behind the Binance hack keep converting stolen tokens into bitcoin, according to blockchain analysts, though trackers disagree on how much. Binance is still working to reopen withdrawals for all tokens on restored networks.
points: Elliptic says stolen altcoins have been converted into roughly 2,300 BTC, worth about $175M, in new addresses; Arkham data cited by Bitcoin.com shows no matching 2,300 BTC addition.
Elliptic puts the theft at $6.43B, with $2.85B frozen or seized and $3.11B still in linked addresses, per Decrypt.
Binance aims to restore withdrawals for all tokens on restored networks by the end of the week of 9 Nov, per Decrypt.
TRM Labs attributes the hack to North Korean hackers, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Prediction-market bet before a poll draws a probe
briefs.summary: Vanderbilt researchers flagged a Polymarket bet of almost $200K placed about an hour before a NYT/Siena poll came out; Polymarket is investigating, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Crypto-in-401(k) rule reaches the White House
briefs.summary: The Labor Department's rule to ease alternative assets such as crypto into 401(k) plans is at the White House for final review, which can take up to 90 days, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Gnosis Pay data breach
briefs.summary: Leaked Gnosis Pay data includes card numbers, CVVs, names, addresses and linked wallet addresses; funds are reported safe, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Strive adds 15,124 bitcoin
briefs.summary: Strive bought 15,124 BTC in October, bringing its holdings to 43,124 BTC, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Russia opens retail crypto trading on 17 Nov
briefs.summary: Retail BTC, ETH and USDT trading starts 17 Nov, with non-qualified investors capped at 300,000 rubles a year per intermediary, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Greece approves a 10% crypto gains tax
briefs.summary: Greece approved a 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% on staking and DeFi income from 1 Jan 2027, with a €500 yearly exemption, per Cointelegraph.
